# PR #1962: Patch: card-on-card verbs for Stinkyscape

Closes #1850

## Summary

This branch adds Stinkyscape phase 0's seven card-on-card verbs to the engine: copying text, the Duo mark, exile auras, holding a card beneath another, the stolen cast, Radiant at N keywords, and Crater on a Field Spell. No Stinkyscape card is added. Each verb is proved on fixture scripts, has a ruling note in #1850's block (R1850000–R1850006) and has its §6 row. All new state is optional and left out of the serialized state when absent, so no shipped game changes: the golden traces replay unchanged, the fuzz gate passes, and there is no patch fragment.

### The verbs

- **R1850000 Copy a Unit's text** (`copy_unit_text`). The copier keeps its own stats and name and takes the source's keywords, aura, triggers, Death, Activate and numbers, plus the Radiant text when that option is set. The copied text is stored in the card's memory under `UNIT_TEXT_KEY`, so R78's reset ends it. Every place that reads a card's script now goes through `unit_text::text_def_of`.
- **R1850001 Duo / Squad** (`duo_radiant`, `squad_radiant`). A public gold `duo` mark; at the start of the marker's next turn the card is made Radiant. A card that leaves first is not made Radiant (R174), and Dormant cards are skipped. The client draws the mark from `viewFor` alone (`marks.ts`).
- **R1850002 Exile auras** (`Script.exile_auras`). A cost cap and/or spared keyword kinds (`not_keywords`, for Scornboi's Starship and Starship Piece). It reaches any side, or the enemy's only. It runs at the state check, and face-down cards are never reached.
- **R1850003 Hold beneath** (`hold_beneath`). A face-up permanent waits in `state.held` until its holder leaves the field, by any route. It then comes back as a summon (R64's zone, summoning sick, no Cry), or is exiled if there is no room. It adds one new event, `held`, with its animation, sound cue and log rows.
- **R1850004 Cast for yourself.** A Spell whose announced targets are all its caster's own hero or permanents is countered and cast by the trap's owner, restricted to their own side (`friends_only`).
- **R1850005 Radiant at N keywords** (`Script.radiant_at_keywords`). Distinct keyword kinds are counted through the layers.
- **R1850006 Crater on a Field Spell.** It Locks its backrow zone as it enters.

The state-check steps live in `card_on_card.rs`. Each one answers true only when it changed something.

## The review's findings: both held and are fixed

1. **Rollback vs. a held card (`board_history.rs`).** The finding held: `restore_board` builds placements with `find_instance`, which never looks in `state.held`. A rolled-back side therefore got the snapshot's copy of the held card back on the field while its `held` entry stayed, so the holder leaving later summoned the card a second time.
   - **Fix:** `restore_board` now drops the `held` entry of every card it places. R419 says a restored card is "moved from wherever it is now", and under a holder counts as one of those places.
   - **Test:** `r1850003_a_rollback_moves_a_held_card_back_and_it_is_held_no_longer`. The card returns to its zone, `state.held` is empty, and after the card and then its holder are destroyed, nothing is summoned.
   - **Note:** R1850003 records the decision. The rejected alternative was to have the Rollback skip a held card, which would leave the zone the snapshot holds it in empty.
2. **The fuzz's hidden-information monitor, I6 (`testkit/invariants.rs`).** The finding held: `cards_of` did not include `state.held`, so a held card was read as "a card in no pile (it ceased to exist)" and flagged as hidden.
   - **Fix:** `cards_of` now includes the held cards. They were face-up when taken, so both seats may read them.
   - **Test:** `r1850003_a_held_card_reads_to_both_seats_held_and_released` runs `create_invariant_monitor(..).hidden(..)` on a real hold, and again after the card is released.

I reverted the two fixes and ran the tests: both failed, the I6 one with the same message the reviewer saw. With the fixes restored, both pass.

## Decisions

- **Copy text:** Cry is not copied; copying stats would be a Transform. A copied copy is copied in turn, and an Immutable source may be copied. It is reported by an in-place `transformed` (rejected: a new event).
- **Duo / Squad:** any permanent, face-down included; Radiant cards are skipped; Squad uses the same mark as Duo.
- **Exile aura:** face-down cards are passed by because their cost is hidden. Cards are exiled at the state check in board order, active player first (rejected: all at once).
- **Hold:**
  - Face-up cards only; a token ceases to exist (R11).
  - The card is released whenever the holder leaves, by any route (rejected: only at its Death).
  - With no room it is exiled (rejected: sent to the graveyard).
  - A holder that is still on the field but buried under a Stack pile's top or Dormant still holds.
  - New this pass: a Rollback that restores the card moves it out from under its holder (rejected: skipping it).
- **Cast for yourself:** a Spell with no targets is not beneficial. The thief's counter (R448) comes first, then the cast.
- **N keywords:** each keyword kind counts once, read through the layers.

## Testing

What I ran this pass:
- **Rust:** `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` are clean. `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` exits 0 (golden replays included) and leaves `apps/web/src/wire/` and `jackioh.luau` unchanged.
- **Spec:** `cargo jackioh spec index` ran (INDEX.md unchanged) and `cargo jackioh spec check` is ok.
- **Gates:** `cargo jackioh catalog check` and `patches check` pass. `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200`: 200 passed, 0 invariant violations.
- **R1850003 tests:** 9 of 9 pass.

The web client was not touched this pass. Earlier passes ran its typecheck, eslint, the touched test files and the harness's `--changed` set green, and `classify --base origin/main --claims` reported App with no card that plays differently.

# #1850: Patch: card-on-card verbs for Stinkyscape
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Phase 0 of the Stinkyscape set: a mechanic merged on `main` without the set. No card reaches it until fullsend 1 ships the set; its Stinkyscape cards are built later, in S04, S15, S16, S17.

## The verbs

Each with the Stinkyscape card that uses it:

- **Copy a Unit's text** (#20 Tnack Trav: a Legendary or Mythic Unit's, its Radiant text on the Radiant face).
- **Duo and Squad** (#110 iKwzki): a mark that makes a permanent (Squad: every permanent of yours) Radiant at your next turn, shown with the Allure animation recoloured.
- **Exile auras** (#113 A Very Dandy Lad: permanents that cost (2) or less; #115 Scornboi: Units that are neither Human, Starship Piece nor Starship), on the Radiant faces the enemy's alone.
- **Hold a permanent beneath a card until it leaves** (#9 Ticketed: returned to its controller at its Death; #135.1 Sack: the Unit summoned at its Death).
- **A beneficial Spell, cast for yourself instead** (#139 Wormhole): a Spell whose chosen targets are all its caster's own hero or permanents, countered and cast by the trap's owner on their own side (its Radiant version on the Radiant face).
- **Radiant on reaching N keywords** (#16 Rod of Ages: 10).
- **Crater on a Field Spell** (#155 Comet Crash): it Locks its backrow zone as it enters, where today Crater does nothing on a Field Spell (§6.1).

## Done when

- Each verb is an engine primitive (`crates/engine`), proved on fixture scripts (`crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/`, the `testkit`'s `scenario()`), its edges included. No Stinkyscape card is needed or added: the cards come later, behind the set's gate.
- Its §6 row, and ruling notes from this issue's block, R(N×1000) up, each named after its proving test (CLAUDE.md rule 3); `cargo jackioh spec index` and `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- A new event has its `ANIMATIONS` and `SOUND_CUES` rows; a new prompt or action is answered by `crates/ai`, the random policy and the timeout, and `legalActions`, the reducer's refusal and the view agree.
- The client's piece, where a verb has one (the Duo mark), renders `viewFor` alone (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- New state is optional and skipped when absent, so no shipped game changes: no golden trace moves and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` names no card that plays differently (plan D3).
- Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9) and the pure crates stay pure (rule 4).
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, and the web's typecheck and tests where the client changed.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST3, ST5); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).
